title: NEMA tsunami forecast following the March 2021 Kermadec earthquakes
altText: National Emergency Management Agency map showing forecast tsunami effects around New Zealand in March 2021.
caption: Official tsunami forecast map issued on 5 March 2021 following large earthquakes near the Kermadec Islands.
context: An identifiable emergency-management map product that demonstrates geographic information used for public safety communication. It relates to disaster warnings, rather than police operational mapping.
